title: Clarify operator vs curator mental model and UX
description: The operator/curator role distinction is confusing in practice. Who is what and when isn't clear — need to audit the role naming, the redirect logic, and possibly the UI labels to make it obvious which view you're in and why. Kimberly = operator (uploads bags, manages collections). Rachel et al = curator (ranks bags). May also want to reconsider terminology if 'curator' and 'operator' don't resonate naturally.
